cases.summary: The binary under test reports itself compatible with schema/released.openrpc.json (ovis-terminal --json schema compat --released). The same binary is staged for this host, sealed into a checksummed archive, unpacked as an installer would and run natively: versions, manual, schema and released compatibility agree, every file re-hashes and the notices list every Cargo.lock crate with the Apache-2.0 attribution. A complete five-target matrix with native receipts promotes as a dry run that never publishes and states that nothing is signed.

cases.summary: A released baseline of the same generation that requires an output this build lacks makes the binary answer compatibility_break, the stage exit 1 with no entry written and the repository baseline unchanged. A tampered binary is checksum_mismatch, an entry with an unknown field is manifest_malformed, a matrix without the Windows artifact is target_missing, a missing native QA receipt is native_qa_missing, a macOS receipt from a Linux host is cross_build_refused, an unpinned SQLite is target_receipt_invalid, lost Apache attribution is notices_missing, a rerun after publication is already_published with publish false, and a rerun with different artifacts is release_conflict. With --inject only the named fixture runs.
